newsitem.title: USA: WALL STREET SHARES WEAK, WATCHING BONDS.
newsitem.headline: WALL STREET SHARES WEAK, WATCHING BONDS.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were soft in late morning trade on Monday, hampered by the sluggish bond market and uneasy about upcoming economic data following steep declines at the end of last week.
The Dow Jones Industrial average, which suffered steep losses on Friday amid rising bond yields, was off 25 points at 8006, near session lows.
The long bond restrained the stock market, losing 9/32 to yield 6.66 percent.
The Nasdaq composite lost nearly one percent, trading down 15 points at 1584.
